about.title: Welcome to the other side of the screen.
about.text: My name is Amir. Passionate about IT, I switched to this field after a first year of a business degree, and I'm now studying for a BTS SIO (IT services) at CFA ITIS in Évry-Courcouronnes. In my free time, I build websites with Next.js and React, and I write scripts to automate repetitive tasks. I enjoy field work just as much: upgrading, installing, configuring and troubleshooting workstations. And above all, helping others, whether they are users or people close to me.
